name: tOrder
description: Sort a DataFrame by one or more columns, with configurable direction and NaN placement (pandas sort_values).
usage: ``columns`` lists the sort keys (a single name or a list). ``ascending`` is a single bool applied to all, or a list with one bool per column. ``na_position`` controls whether NaNs go first or last.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Column name or list of column names to sort by.

attributes.name: ascending
attributes.description: Sort direction: a single bool for all columns, or a list with one bool per column (``True`` = ascending). Default ``True``.

attributes.name: na_position
attributes.description: Where to place NaN values — ``first`` or ``last`` (default).

attributes.name: pd_args
attributes.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to pandas ``sort_values``.

json_schema.title: tOrder

ascending.description: Single direction or one per column.

na_position.description: Where to place NaN values — ``first`` or ``last`` (default).

pd_args.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to pandas ``sort_values``.
